hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */proscenium/ext/*) echo 'BLOCK: Compiled binaries in ext/ should not be edited. Use rake compile:local.' >&2; exit 2;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [[ "$f" == *.rb ]] && bundle exec rubocop -A --fail-level E "$f" || true
